vision.name: Janemba's Hell Gate
vision.text:
ENDURANCE 1.
(This card is considered Styled.)
[Attack] 1: Energy attack.
Focused. Rejuvenate X. X = the number of cards attached to your MP to a maximum of 5.
DAMAGE: 4 life cards.
HIT: Return a non-Named [Attack] card attached to your MP to its owner's hand.
(Banish after use.)
vision.note: Organized Play card (OP6 folder); grey card; possessive title -> Named; stage cost printed as '1:'; the crossed-swords icon in 'non-Named [Attack] card' is the Attack icon
